_comment: The DMG window's words. Edit here, then run `make dmg-art` (scripts/dmg-art.sh). Keep them in step with docs/APPROVALS.md and the app's own texts, and honest: the update check is the app's only network use.
title: Drag Stage Manager into Applications
approvals_heading: Then open it. Stage Manager walks you through:

approvals.name: Turn off Apple’s Stage Manager
approvals.why: Stage Manager offers to do it for you.

approvals.name: Accessibility
approvals.why: Lets Stage Manager move, hide and bring back your windows.

approvals.name: Screen Recording
approvals.why: Live pictures of your windows on the cards. Without it, cards show plain window shapes with the app’s icon.

privacy: Nothing about your windows leaves your Mac. Update checks: once a day, from GitHub. Nothing about you or this Mac is sent.
